thread:
Maria CSM: Quick triage — Wavebridge renewal flagged. Usage down ~42% last 30d (sharp drop after 2026-03-03) and their ML lead left last week. Procurement just pinged for a competitive comparison. We have a renewal review in 10 days. Can we align on a playbook? /cc @Sam AE @Devon SE
Neil CSM: Adding context: top 5 active users down from ~120 -> 45. Support ticket #4521 shows repeated timeouts in feature-extraction jobs. I uploaded a short health summary: https://redwood.docs/wavebridge/health-report
Sam AE: Noted. I can re-open procurement lane. Do we have any quick ROI wins to stall a renewal decision? Any pricing levers we should prep? :thinking_face:
Devon SE: We can propose a 2-week Dedicated pilot to demonstrate throughput + KV-cache improvements. Need infra metrics and a focused eval prompt set. Expect ~30% latency improvement and ~20% token-cost reduction based on similar accounts.
Maria CSM: Perfect. Neil — can you pull last 30d token usage + top error types and format as CSV? Also capture recent eval failures (prompt IDs).
Neil CSM: On it. Running the query now:
```sql
SELECT date, tokens_out, errors
FROM usage_metrics
WHERE account = 'wavebridge' AND date > '2026-02-01'
ORDER BY date;
```
Will attach CSV here in a bit.
OpsBot: Reminder — Wavebridge renewal date is 2026-04-15. SLA tier: standard. Legal: competitive-clause review in progress.
Sam AE: I'll schedule a 30m exec sync between their CPO and our Head of Sales for next Tue. Need the CSV + a 1-pager on the Dedicated pilot. @Devon SE can you draft the one-pager by EOD Fri?
Devon SE: Drafting now. Will include expected latency/cost deltas, required infra (GPU type + pool size), and success criteria (throughput > 200 req/s, token cost < $0.002).
Maria CSM: Also request: can eng-runtime prepare a safety fallback plan (auto-fallback to a smaller model) for the POC? If they see variance we need graceful degradation evidence.
Neil CSM: CSV uploaded: /files/wavebridge-usage-30d.csv. Key notes: spike in model timeouts on 2026-03-03 that lines up with a model rollout. Flagged to eng-runtime and support for deeper trace.
Devon SE: Adding a config snippet for the POC fallback plan:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - model: redwood-small-v1
    when: latency > 1200ms or errors > 1%
```
Maria CSM: Great. Next actions:
- Sam AE: schedule exec sync Tue and keep procurement on standby
- Devon SE: pilot one-pager + fallback snippet by EOD Fri
- Neil CSM: gather usage CSV + ticket thread and attach to the playbook
I'll own the renewal playbook and customer comms. Reconvene Mon 09:30 for runbook review. :thumbsup:
Sam AE: +1. If competitor is offering embedded model credits, we may propose a limited uplift credit to maintain momentum. I'll coordinate terms with finance.
Devon SE: I'll also prepare a 10-prompt demo that highlights their latency-sensitive flows for the demo call.
Maria CSM: Thanks team — flagging account label renewal-risk:high and adding this thread to the playbook doc. Will update if procurement sends an RFP. End thread.
